open_points.subject: _encrypt_backup
open_points.text: _encrypt_backup: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST seal under an AES-GCM key of the imported BACKUP_KEY_BYTES constant in bytes, derived by HKDF with the hash the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_HASH constant names and no salt from the bytes of backup_key with those of the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_INFO constant as its info, both encoded by the imported TEXT_ENCODING constant, using the cryptography package, and MUST pass the record line's bytes without its line feed as the associated data, so that a changed record fails the decryption.
open_points.other_text:
Reflective attribute access is rejected: never call getattr, hasattr,
  setattr, delattr, or vars; a declared field or operation is
  addressed by its name, including in try/finally cleanup, and a
  model's fields read generically come from iterating the model,
  in place or inside an imported operation that does so.
open_points.question: Either import a declared operation that resolves BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_HASH to a cryptography hash algorithm (or import the algorithm symbol directly), or permit the reflective lookup needed to resolve the runtime string; otherwise the named hash cannot be selected without inventing an inline name-to-algorithm table.
